context: News discussion about rising prices and a recession warning
purpose: Teach: たんぱく/物価/不景気/危険性/ハンドル/急速/細かい/アクセス

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今朝のニュース見た？物価がまた上がってるって。
lines.en: Did you see the news this morning? Prices are going up again.
lines.style: Calm teacher voice, opens with gentle morning concern

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 見ました。たんぱく質が多い食品まで急速に値上がりしてて、びっくりです。
lines.en: I saw it. Even protein-rich foods are rapidly getting more expensive, it's shocking.
lines.style: Young male university student, surprised and slightly worried

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 経済の専門家が不景気になる危険性を訴えてたわね。
lines.en: The economists were warning about the risk of a recession, weren't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful teacher, measured and informed tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、政府がもっと細かい対策を出すべきだって言ってましたよ。
lines.en: Yes, they were saying the government should put out more detailed measures.
lines.style: Engaged student voice, citing what he heard on news

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 結局、経済のハンドルを握ってるのは私たち一人一人の消費なのよね。
lines.en: In the end, it's each of our spending that holds the steering wheel of the economy.
lines.style: Reflective teacher tone, sharing a thoughtful observation

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうですね。ネットでもこの話題、アクセスがすごく多いみたいです。
lines.en: That's true. This topic seems to be getting a lot of traffic online too.
lines.style: Curious student adding modern internet-savvy perspective

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今夜もう一度ちゃんと確認するつもり。心配だわ。
lines.en: I'm planning to check it properly again tonight. I'm worried.
lines.style: Soft concerned teacher closing the conversation gently
